title: Chicken and Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: A quick, colorful stir-fry of tender chicken, broccoli, peppers and snow peas in a savory ginger-garlic sauce. Ready in 30 minutes.

image.alt: A wok of chicken with broccoli, peppers and snap peas in a glossy sauce

ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs

steps.text: Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce. In a small bowl, stir the rest of the soy sauce, the oyster sauce, sugar, 2 tsp cornstarch and {qty 1/3 cup} water.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken in one layer until browned and just cooked through, {time 3-4 min}. Move to a plate.
Add another tablespoon of oil and the broccoli with a splash of water. Stir-fry until bright green, {time 2 min}, then add the pepper and snow peas for {time 2 min} more.
Push the vegetables aside, add the last of the oil with the garlic and ginger and stir for {time 30 sec}.
Return the chicken, stir the sauce and pour it in. Toss until glossy and thickened, {time 1 min}. Drizzle with sesame oil and serve over rice.

notes: Have everything chopped before you start; stir-frying moves fast.
Any quick-cooking vegetables work: sliced carrots, mushrooms, bok choy or zucchini.
